# Requirements Review Checklist: Split View for up to Four Videos

**Purpose**: Review the quality of the split view's requirements (spec, plan and contract) before task breakdown: interaction, several sources at once, performance, accessibility
**Created**: 2026-10-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [contracts/split-view.md](../contracts/split-view.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Is the behaviour of Stop while a video fills the area specified in the spec, or does it exist only as a planning decision in the contract? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, Contract §Focus and full screen]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are the requirements for what F (full screen) does while a video is focused, and while focused in full screen, stated in the spec, or only in the contract's table? [Gap, Spec §FR-023, Contract §Focus and full screen]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the state defined for when every tile has been closed or removed at once (for example the playlist is cleared during a split view)? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is opening a different playlist (File > Open Playlist, or loading a remote playlist) during a split view specified: do the tiles whose entries disappear close, and what plays afterwards? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are requirements defined for dropping several files at once onto a tile or onto empty space, including when only some of them fit within four? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is "Play in split view" specified for entries marked unavailable (missing local files)? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK007 - Does the spec say where a non-selected tile's state is shown: its "Reconnecting…", buffering and failure indicators on the tile itself, or only when it is selected? [Gap, Spec §FR-026, §FR-024]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 - Is "in playlist order" defined for a playlist that is sorted, filtered or grouped in the view: the file's order or the order shown? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004, US1 scenario 1]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is FR-021's "the paused videos MUST play on" limited to the videos the focus paused, as the plan decides, so that a video the user had paused stays paused? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-021, Plan R8]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is "live stream" defined for FR-018 by reference to the single view's existing rule (LIVE badge), so that live HLS and RTSP are both covered and an on-demand HLS stream pauses like a file? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is "show which entries are in the split view" given a concrete form (position number, marker) in the spec, or only in the contract? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, Contract §Selection and sound]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the form and placement of a failure message in a split view specified (dialog, snackbar or on the tile), beyond "MUST name that video"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025, Contract §Each tile's life]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is "unavailable" for the mini player defined as a visible state of its button (disabled with a tooltip, or hidden)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-029]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 - Is the Background's "pauses the others" (quoted from the issue) reconciled with FR-017 and FR-018, which pause files only? [Consistency, Spec §Background, §FR-017, §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are the selection rules consistent across start, add, replace, close, end and focus (top-left on start and close, unchanged on add, the focused tile on focus)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, §FR-001, US4 scenario 2, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is FR-024a's "next or previous playlist entry" consistent with the contract's order (play-next queue first, then shuffle or view order)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024a, Contract §Ways in and out]
- [ ] CHK017 - Do FR-020 (Esc) and the window's existing Esc chain (clear search, close the playlist panel, leave full screen) have a defined order, so that one press does one thing? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, Plan R8]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are the credential rules of feature 004 (display address only) explicitly applied to the new texts: tile titles in failure messages and tiles' accessible names? [Consistency, Spec §FR-025, Contract §Each tile's life]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK019 - Is "a machine with hardware video decoding" in SC-003 pinned to a reference machine or class, so that a pass or fail is repeatable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK020 - Does SC-005 give a time within which four cameras must all be playing, given that the plan opens them one at a time? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, Plan R4]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is "at a glance" in FR-011 tied to a measurable property of the selection mark (the contract's 2-pixel accent border), and is that property part of the spec? [Measurability, Spec §FR-011, Contract §Selection and sound]
- [ ] CHK022 - Is the way SC-002's 0.3 seconds and SC-003's 100 milliseconds are measured stated, or left to the tester? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, §SC-003]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 - Are requirements defined for changing the RTSP transport setting while several cameras play: does it apply to every tile's next open? [Coverage, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is the same address appearing as two different playlist entries (for example one camera listed twice) addressed: two tiles of one source, or one? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases "same entry is chosen twice"]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are requirements stated for a click on a zoomed-in tile, where a press already starts panning: does it select, pan, or both? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is the behaviour of the window being minimised or hidden during a split view (keep playing, as a single video does) stated? [Coverage, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK027 - Is the delay a camera that does not answer causes to the cameras opened after it addressed in the requirements or accepted as an assumption? [Edge Case, Plan R4, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK028 - Is a minimum tile or window size defined, or is "every tile stays visible, however small" intended without a limit? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK029 - Is a memory or processor budget for four players stated, or accepted as an assumption (the plan measured about 170 MB per extra player)? [Gap, Plan R1]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is the cost of decoding hidden live tiles while another is focused acknowledged as accepted? [Assumption, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK031 - Does the spec require that the selected tile can be told apart without relying on colour alone? [Accessibility, Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK032 - Are screen-reader requirements (each tile's name, which one is selected) in the spec rather than only in the plan's decisions? [Accessibility, Gap, Plan §Decisions made in planning]
- [ ] CHK033 - Can every split-view action be done from the keyboard alone: starting from the playlist, ending it, closing a tile, focusing and leaving focus? [Accessibility, Coverage, Spec §FR-001, §FR-005, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK034 - Is the behaviour of 1–4 defined when a text field has keyboard focus (the playlist search), and for keyboards where digits need Shift or for the number pad? [Accessibility, Edge Case, Spec §FR-010]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK035 - Is the assumption that keys 1 to 4 have no other meaning in GAV recorded as checked, including the number pad? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK036 - Is the dependency on feature 004's RTSP behaviour (transport memory, failure kinds, reconnecting) listed, with the changes the plan makes to it? [Dependency, Spec §FR-027, Plan R4]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
